acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Versioned state and transition-event schemas define the shared lifecycle vocabulary.
Every normative legal transition is executable and tested.
Invalid, duplicate, out-of-order and post-terminal events are deterministically rejected.
Invocation, correlation and exact release context are preserved.
Transition events carry prior/resulting state, reason and causal source context.
Replay is explicit; stale revisions reject and concurrent persistence requires compare-and-swap.
Cancellation is terminal but only accepted from an explicit governed control; PSI-44 envelope v1.0 does not gain cancellation semantics.
The state model is pure and does not execute, authorize or persist work.
